audience: project-based service firms that run projects, timesheets and invoices in WorkGuru

useCases.title: Review open projects for one client
useCases.text: List the clients to get their ids. Then list the projects with their status, dates, project manager and line items.

useCases.title: Check invoices and their clients
useCases.text: List the invoices with their number, date, due date, status and totals. Use the client list to match each invoice to a client.

useCases.title: Track hours by staff member and task
useCases.text: List the timesheet entries for a date range, optionally for one staff member, with project, task and hours. List the task types to see their rates.

useCases.title: Review open leads and their contacts
useCases.text: List the leads with their stage, owner, budget and forecast close date. List the contacts with their name, e-mail, phone and position.

useCases.title: Check the product catalogue
useCases.text: List the products with their price, cost, stock and unit of measure.
